results.name: handler failure identity and replacement
results.source:
import codecs
assert input() == 'ready'
failure = ValueError('handler failed')
def handler(error):
    raise failure
codecs.register_error('handler', handler)
try:
    b'\xff'.decode('ascii', 'handler')
except ValueError as caught:
    print(caught is failure, caught.args)
codecs.register_error('handler', lambda error: ('!', error.end))
print(b'\xff'.decode('ascii', 'handler'))
